projects.name: Enterprise Knowledge Assistant (RAG)
projects.description: An internal knowledge assistant that answers questions from tenant-owned policies, manuals, and operational documents with verifiable citations and safe abstention.
features: PDF and office-document ingestion with durable job status
Hybrid lexical + vector retrieval with metadata and tenant filters
Reranking behind a replaceable interface
Answers grounded in page-level citations
Unanswerable-question handling and feedback capture
Retrieval and answer evaluation datasets
requirements: Write a concise problem statement, architecture diagram, and key tradeoff decisions.
Use ASP.NET Core 10 for the backend API; keep model/provider calls behind application interfaces.
Add unit, integration, security, and failure-path tests; do not rely on manual demos alone.
Publish Docker Compose setup, environment-variable template, API docs, runbook, and a polished GitHub README.
Treat document content as untrusted; prove prompt-injection and cross-tenant isolation defenses.
Define retention and deletion semantics for source files, extracted text, chunks, embeddings, and logs.

milestones.title: Problem definition and threat model
milestones.description: Define users, source collections, answer expectations, privacy boundaries, and abuse cases.
tasks: Choose a concrete knowledge domain such as HR policy or support operations.
Specify answerable and unanswerable cases plus citation requirements.
Draw ingestion/query diagrams and identify trust boundaries.
milestones.deliverable: Problem brief, architecture diagram, and threat model.

milestones.title: Document ingestion pipeline
milestones.description: Build a restartable ingestion workflow with status, validation, and safe failure handling.
tasks: Add authenticated upload and file type/size validation.
Extract text with page and section metadata.
Persist processing status and retryable versus permanent failures.
milestones.deliverable: A document can be uploaded and inspected with processing status.

milestones.title: Chunking and embedding lifecycle
milestones.description: Create versioned chunks that can be reprocessed when extraction or embedding models change.
tasks: Compare fixed-size and structure-aware chunking on sample files.
Generate and store embeddings with model/dimension metadata.
Implement document re-ingestion and deletion.
milestones.deliverable: Versioned chunk records with source traceability.

milestones.title: Hybrid retrieval and reranking
milestones.description: Retrieve relevant evidence with exact identifier support and measurable ranking quality.
tasks: Implement tenant- and collection-scoped vector retrieval.
Add lexical search and a documented fusion strategy.
Evaluate optional reranking against the same query set.
milestones.deliverable: Retrieval benchmark comparing lexical, vector, and hybrid methods.

milestones.title: Grounded answer API
milestones.description: Return answers users can audit rather than unsupported confident prose.
tasks: Build context from top evidence with explicit trust boundaries.
Return citations from server-known source IDs, pages, and excerpts.
Abstain and explain missing evidence when confidence/evidence criteria fail.
milestones.deliverable: Streaming answer endpoint with validated citations.

milestones.title: Evaluation, security, and demo
milestones.description: Prove quality, tenant isolation, and failure behavior in a reviewable portfolio demo.
tasks: Create golden queries with expected evidence and unanswerable examples.
Measure retrieval hit rate, citation validity, latency, and cost.
Test malicious documents, cross-tenant access, provider timeout, and deletion.
Deploy with traces, dashboards/metrics, runbook, and recorded demo.
milestones.deliverable: Deployed RAG system with an evaluation report and security test evidence.

projects.name: Customer Support Resolution Copilot
projects.description: A support agent copilot that summarizes case history, retrieves approved knowledge, drafts replies, and recommends next steps without sending messages autonomously.
features: Case timeline summarization with source references
Knowledge retrieval grounded in approved articles
Draft response with policy and evidence links
Human review/edit/approve workflow
PII redaction and role-aware data access
Feedback and resolution outcome tracking
requirements: Write a concise problem statement, architecture diagram, and key tradeoff decisions.
Use ASP.NET Core 10 for the backend API; keep model/provider calls behind application interfaces.
Add unit, integration, security, and failure-path tests; do not rely on manual demos alone.
Publish Docker Compose setup, environment-variable template, API docs, runbook, and a polished GitHub README.
The assistant may draft but cannot send or close customer cases without an authorized human action.
Use synthetic or anonymized data and document PII handling.

milestones.title: Support workflow and safety boundary
milestones.description: Map a real support journey and identify what the model may suggest versus execute.
tasks: Define agent personas, case states, and supported intents.
Create a permission matrix for customer data and actions.
Write acceptance criteria for citation quality and safe fallback.
milestones.deliverable: Workflow map, permission matrix, and evaluation plan.

milestones.title: Case context and knowledge retrieval
milestones.description: Assemble only relevant, authorized context from case history and approved knowledge.
tasks: Create case timeline API and tenant-scoped access.
Index support articles with version and publication status.
Retrieve evidence using filters and hybrid search.
milestones.deliverable: Authorized case context and retrieval service.

milestones.title: Summary and response drafting
milestones.description: Generate concise drafts with traceable factual claims.
tasks: Create structured case summary and missing-information fields.
Draft a customer response tied to evidence IDs.
Add output validation, redaction, and unsupported-claim checks.
milestones.deliverable: Case summary and editable cited reply draft.

milestones.title: Human review and feedback
milestones.description: Keep the support professional in control and capture useful outcomes.
tasks: Add approve/edit/reject workflow with actor and timestamp.
Never auto-send; record final approved content separately.
Capture usefulness and resolution feedback.
milestones.deliverable: Auditable human-reviewed case workflow.

milestones.title: Quality and production hardening
milestones.description: Measure whether the copilot improves response quality without adding risk.
tasks: Build golden cases across routine, ambiguous, and adversarial requests.
Evaluate factuality, citation coverage, and PII leakage.
Add streaming, cancellation, timeouts, cost limits, telemetry, and demo.
milestones.deliverable: A/B-style evaluation report and production-ready demonstration.

projects.name: Intelligent Document Operations Workflow
projects.description: An enterprise document processing service that classifies incoming contracts or invoices, extracts typed fields, flags exceptions, and routes work for human review.
features: Document classification and schema-constrained extraction
Confidence and evidence spans for extracted values
Business rule validation and exception queue
Human correction workflow and audit history
Idempotent asynchronous processing
Evaluation by document type and field
requirements: Write a concise problem statement, architecture diagram, and key tradeoff decisions.
Use ASP.NET Core 10 for the backend API; keep model/provider calls behind application interfaces.
Add unit, integration, security, and failure-path tests; do not rely on manual demos alone.
Publish Docker Compose setup, environment-variable template, API docs, runbook, and a polished GitHub README.
Model-extracted fields are suggestions until validated; consequential accounting or legal decisions require human review.
Store minimal document content and define retention/deletion controls.

milestones.title: Choose workflow and define data contract
milestones.description: Select one bounded document process with measurable business value.
tasks: Choose invoice intake, contract clause review, or purchase-order matching.
Define typed output schema, required evidence spans, and exception categories.
Map current manual workflow and target service-level indicators.
milestones.deliverable: Problem case, typed schema, and success metrics.

milestones.title: Secure asynchronous intake
milestones.description: Accept documents reliably without blocking HTTP requests.
tasks: Implement authenticated upload and idempotency.
Store document reference and enqueue processing job.
Apply file validation, malware scanning integration point, and tenant scope.
milestones.deliverable: Secure intake API and observable job lifecycle.

milestones.title: Extraction and validation pipeline
milestones.description: Combine model extraction with deterministic domain rules.
tasks: Extract structured fields and evidence spans.
Validate dates, totals, identifiers, and cross-field consistency.
Route low-confidence or conflicting fields to review.
milestones.deliverable: Typed extraction result with field-level validation.

milestones.title: Human review and audit
milestones.description: Make corrections attributable and replayable.
tasks: Build review queue for exceptions.
Allow reviewers to correct fields and record reasons.
Store model/prompt version and before/after values in audit history.
milestones.deliverable: Review UI and immutable audit trail.

milestones.title: Evaluation and operations
milestones.description: Demonstrate accuracy and safe handling across document variation.
tasks: Create labeled documents covering clean, noisy, and adversarial inputs.
Measure field precision/recall and exception routing accuracy.
Test duplicate jobs, worker crash/retry, deletion, and tenant boundaries.
Package deployment and publish a measured case study.
milestones.deliverable: Document workflow with evaluation results and operational runbook.

projects.name: Secure ERP Action Assistant
projects.description: An AI assistant for ERP operators that answers questions and prepares bounded customer, invoice, and order actions, with application-enforced authorization and approval before writes.
technologies: Semantic Kernel or Microsoft Agent Framework
features: Read-only customer/invoice/order tools with narrow contracts
Role-, tenant-, and record-level authorization
Approval-bound write operations with expiry and idempotency
Execution limits, retries, and complete audit records
Conversation streaming and resumable workflow status
Adversarial tool-use evaluation
requirements: Write a concise problem statement, architecture diagram, and key tradeoff decisions.
Use ASP.NET Core 10 for the backend API; keep model/provider calls behind application interfaces.
Add unit, integration, security, and failure-path tests; do not rely on manual demos alone.
Publish Docker Compose setup, environment-variable template, API docs, runbook, and a polished GitHub README.
The model never determines user permissions; each tool re-authorizes against the authenticated actor.
Writes require explicit approval bound to exact arguments and expire when stale.

milestones.title: Select a high-value business workflow
milestones.description: Start with a real enterprise process rather than a generic chatbot.
tasks: Choose one workflow such as invoice dispute triage or order hold review.
Document actors, required data, permissions, side effects, and approval rules.
Define explicit non-goals and refusal/escalation conditions.
milestones.deliverable: Workflow specification and threat model.

milestones.title: Secure business tool layer
milestones.description: Expose focused operations that enforce business rules independent of the LLM.
tasks: Implement customer, invoice, and order read tools.
Derive tenant/user identity from trusted server context.
Add resource-level authorization tests and data minimization.
milestones.deliverable: Tool API with authorization tests.

milestones.title: Tool calling and workflow state
milestones.description: Use model tool selection inside a bounded state machine.
tasks: Define typed schemas and validation for every tool.
Limit tool count, execution duration, and repeated calls.
Persist workflow state and distinguish proposal, approval, and execution.
milestones.deliverable: Resumable assistant workflow with explicit state transitions.

milestones.title: Approval-gated action execution
milestones.description: Make side effects explicit, authorized, idempotent, and auditable.
tasks: Create approval record bound to actor, action, and immutable arguments.
Re-authorize immediately before execution and reject expired approvals.
Use idempotency keys and store execution outcome.
milestones.deliverable: Auditable approved action flow.

milestones.title: Adversarial evaluation and operations
milestones.description: Show the assistant handles ambiguity, malicious content, and downstream failures safely.
tasks: Create scenarios for prompt injection, privilege escalation, malformed tool calls, and provider outage.
Measure correct tool selection, policy compliance, and refusal/escalation.
Add traces, redacted logs, cost controls, CI evaluation gate, and demo.
milestones.deliverable: Enterprise workflow assistant with security and evaluation evidence.

projects.name: LLM Evaluation and Routing Workbench
projects.description: A platform for comparing prompts, models, and retrieval configurations against versioned enterprise scenarios, then selecting providers by quality, latency, cost, and policy.
features: Versioned golden datasets and prompt registry
Batch evaluation across providers/configurations
Quality, latency, failure, token, and cost comparisons
Human review for subjective outputs
Regression thresholds and CI integration
Policy-aware model routing experiments
requirements: Write a concise problem statement, architecture diagram, and key tradeoff decisions.
Use ASP.NET Core 10 for the backend API; keep model/provider calls behind application interfaces.
Add unit, integration, security, and failure-path tests; do not rely on manual demos alone.
Publish Docker Compose setup, environment-variable template, API docs, runbook, and a polished GitHub README.
Do not report model-judge scores as ground truth; label their limitations and use human review samples.
Avoid storing sensitive prompts/results longer than necessary.

milestones.title: Evaluation model and dataset
milestones.description: Define repeatable cases that reflect real user and business risk.
tasks: Model scenarios, input variables, expected evidence, and scoring criteria.
Version prompts and datasets independently.
Include edge cases, unanswerable cases, and adversarial inputs.
milestones.deliverable: Versioned scenario format and baseline set.

milestones.title: Provider experiment runner
milestones.description: Run controlled comparisons with reproducible configuration.
tasks: Integrate multiple chat/embedding providers behind interfaces.
Add concurrency limits, timeouts, retries, and cancellation.
Record model, prompt, dataset, configuration, and run metadata.
milestones.deliverable: Repeatable background experiment runner.

milestones.title: Metrics and review workspace
milestones.description: Make quality-cost tradeoffs inspectable at both aggregate and case level.
tasks: Track latency percentiles, failures, token use, and cost estimates.
Compare per-case results and prompt/model versions.
Add blind human review for selected subjective dimensions.
milestones.deliverable: Comparison dashboard with case-level drilldown.

milestones.title: Regression and routing policy
milestones.description: Turn experiments into a release decision aid.
tasks: Configure quality and latency thresholds by scenario group.
Prototype routing policies with cost and capability constraints.
Fail CI on critical deterministic regressions and publish artifacts.
milestones.deliverable: Evaluation CI workflow and documented routing tradeoffs.

milestones.title: Reliability, security, and release
milestones.description: Ship a usable internal tool with clear data controls.
tasks: Test dataset access control, prompt redaction, and concurrent runs.
Instrument queue, provider, and evaluation stages.
Deploy and publish architecture, sample dataset, and demo results.
milestones.deliverable: Portfolio-ready evaluation workbench.

projects.name: Multi-Tenant Enterprise AI Assistant Platform
projects.description: A capstone platform combining grounded knowledge, secure business tools, provider abstraction, evaluation, and production operations for multiple enterprise tenants.
features: Tenant-scoped knowledge ingestion and RAG
Provider abstraction with streaming and resilient policies
Bounded, approval-gated business workflows
Conversation history, retention, and access policies
Evaluation gates for retrieval, answers, and tool workflows
Operational telemetry, quotas, and incident runbooks
requirements: Write a concise problem statement, architecture diagram, and key tradeoff decisions.
Use ASP.NET Core 10 for the backend API; keep model/provider calls behind application interfaces.
Add unit, integration, security, and failure-path tests; do not rely on manual demos alone.
Publish Docker Compose setup, environment-variable template, API docs, runbook, and a polished GitHub README.
Publish a clear threat model and demonstrate cross-tenant denial tests.
Keep domain authorization and critical business rules outside model prompts.
Include a live or reproducible demo with synthetic data and honest limitations.

milestones.title: Platform architecture and domain boundary
milestones.description: Design a coherent platform around explicit tenant and capability boundaries.
tasks: Define API, ingestion, retrieval, conversation, tool, evaluation, and worker modules.
Create architecture decision records for provider abstraction and data storage.
Set tenant quotas, data retention, and threat model.
milestones.deliverable: Architecture pack and initial vertical-slice plan.

milestones.title: Identity, tenant isolation, and data lifecycle
milestones.description: Build isolation and deletion into the data model and execution path.
tasks: Implement tenant-aware identity and authorization policies.
Scope relational, vector, cache, job, and object storage access by tenant.
Add retention and deletion workflow with integration tests.
milestones.deliverable: Tenant-safe data foundation with isolation evidence.

milestones.title: Provider gateway and conversation API
milestones.description: Support multiple model providers without leaking provider assumptions across the app.
tasks: Implement configuration-based chat/embedding provider selection.
Add streaming, cancellation, deadlines, usage capture, and bounded retries.
Persist conversation state under access and retention policies.
milestones.deliverable: Observable provider-neutral conversation service.

milestones.title: Knowledge and business capabilities
milestones.description: Combine evidence-based answers with narrowly scoped enterprise actions.
tasks: Integrate document ingestion, hybrid RAG, citations, and feedback.
Integrate a limited set of authorized business tools.
Add approval state machine for every consequential write.
milestones.deliverable: End-to-end grounded assistant with safe business workflow.

milestones.title: Evaluation, security, and SRE controls
milestones.description: Demonstrate measurable quality and operational resilience.
tasks: Run golden RAG and tool-use evaluation suites in CI.
Test injection, cross-tenant leakage, abuse, and failure recovery.
Add traces, metrics, structured redacted logs, health checks, and runbooks.
milestones.deliverable: Release evidence: evaluation, security tests, and operational dashboards.

milestones.title: Portfolio release and technical narrative
milestones.description: Present a project that hiring teams can inspect and run.
tasks: Create architecture and sequence diagrams plus key design decisions.
Provide Docker Compose quick start, seeded synthetic demo, and API docs.
Record a concise demo and write a case study with tradeoffs and limitations.
milestones.deliverable: Polished GitHub repository and interview-ready system walkthrough.
